purpose: Freeze a prospective retry step width from the completed C10.65s2i adaptive trace before any retry execution. This changes only the short canary interval length in a new retry gate; it does not modify the original C10.65s2 result, integrator tolerance, equations, state, or acceptance criterion.

selection_rule.source_quantity: minimum first_accepted_hdid across the four C10.65s2i anchors
selection_rule.rationale: The first accepted hdid at each anchor is the step accepted by the unchanged pinned RKQS controller after shrinking the original trial. A fixed factor 1/2 below the worst-anchor accepted value is frozen before retry, giving margin without changing the error tolerance or acceptance logic.

retry_contract.constraint_drift_policy: measurement only; no new numerical drift threshold

next_if_pass: Execute C10.65s2k as a separate production retry using exactly retry_width_Mpc, unchanged tolerance and equations, and require one accepted/no-rejection Cash-Karp step on all four anchors. Preserve C10.65s2 as FAIL_SCOPED regardless of s2k outcome.
